title: Mushroom Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 tip of teaspoon of dried hot chilli flakes
Celery Salt & freshly ground white pepper
method: In a shallow frying pan heat the olive oil and butter and then add the onion and garlic, cook until they are soft and translucent.
Add the mushrooms little by little allowing each addition to sweat down and cook through, almost caramelise.
Add the paprika and cayenne pepper followed by the yogurt and cream.
Reduce the heat a little and continue to cook the mushrooms until further reduced in size.
Add the parsley and seasoning and serve immediately.
